questions.question: The table given below shows the salary of 6 employees of a company. Employees Salary L 350 M 800 N 500 O 400 P 600 Q 450 What is the ratio of salary of L and M together to the salary of P and Q together?
questions.questionHtml:
The table given below shows the salary of 6 employees of a company.

Employees  Salary
L 350
M 800
N 500
O 400
P 600
Q 450


What is the ratio of salary of L and M together to the salary of P and Q together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Salary of employee L: 350

Salary of employee M: 800

Salary of employee P: 600

Salary of employee Q: 450

Calculation:

To find the ratio of salary of L and M together to the salary of P and Q together, we need to add the salary of L and M and divide it by the sum of salary of P and Q.

Find the sum of salary of L and M

Sum of salary of L and M = 350 + 800 = 1150

Find the sum of salary of P and Q

Sum of salary of P and Q = 600 + 450 = 1050

Find the ratio of salary of L and M together to the salary of P and Q together

Ratio = Sum of salary of L and M / Sum of salary of P and Q = 1150/1050 = 1150 : 1050 = 23 : 21

So, the ratio of salary of L and M together to the salary of P and Q together is 23 : 21.

questions.question: The table below gives the numbers of students from five different colleges who participated in the Olympiads of five different subjects during a given year. Subjects College A College B College C College D College E Hindi 110 100 125 103 112 English 98 120 80 122 105 Maths 130 110 250 160 180 Science 100 100 150 200 80 GK 182 200 120 130 183 Find the average number of students per college who participated in the English Olympiad
questions.questionHtml:

Subjects College A College B College C College D College E
Hindi 110 100 125 103 112
English 98 120 80 122 105
Maths 130 110 250 160 180
Science 100 100 150 200 80
GK 182 200 120 130 183


Find the average number of students per college who participated in the English Olympiad
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Five colleges A, B, C, D, and E

Five different subjects i.e. Hindi, English, Maths, Science, and G.K.

number of students participated in olympiad from 5 different colleges in 5 different subjects

FORMULA USED:
Average = \(sum of values\over number of values\) × 100

CALCULATION:

Number of students participated in English 

⇒ From college A = 98

⇒ From college B = 120

⇒ From college C = 80

⇒ From college D = 122

⇒ From college E = 105

Hence, sum of all the students in English olympiad from 5 colleges,

⇒ 98 + 120 + 80 + 122 + 105 = 525

Number of colleges = 5

⇒ Average = 525/5 = 105.

Hence, the average no. of students per college participated is 105.
